text:
maria: Starting the canary for release v2026.3, deploying to eu-west-1 canary pool.

deploy-bot: deploy started for service=runtime model=redwood-v1.4 canary=10% image=sha256:abc123

slo-monitor: ALERT: p95 latency for /v1/generate spiked to 1.5s (+180%) in eu-west-1 at 2026-03-20T14:07:01Z :warning:

kai: seeing an uptick in 5xx from embedder nodes? anyone else?

rohan: logs show `kv cache miss` churn on node gpu-12, GC during rollout. copying logs:
```
2026-03-20T14:06:59Z runtime/gpu-12 ERROR qkv_cache_eviction took=18ms
2026-03-20T14:07:00Z runtime/gpu-12 WARN request_queue_depth=45
```

maria: can we pause traffic shift to 50%? rollback threshold is p95>1.2s or 5xx rate >0.5%.

deploy-bot: traffic shift paused at 10% by policy `slo-gate` (manual hold)

kai: +1 to pause. recommend pinning to previous image `sha256:ff9a77` for affected region.

rohan: agree. pinning service/runtime eu-west-1 -> image=sha256:ff9a77 and aborting further canary steps.

ops_oncall: I'll run the pin and monitor. kicking rollback to image sha256:ff9a77 now.

slo-monitor: NOTICE: canary rollback initiated by ops_oncall at 2026-03-20T14:10:05Z

maria: ops, can you capture the release notes diff and update the changelog with rollback reason? (latency regression, kv cache churn)

ops_oncall: done. changelog patch: "reverted runtime image causing KV-cache eviction increase in canary"

kai: after rollback, p95 trending back to 0.45s, 5xx normalized. Good catch.

maria: decision: do not promote. we'll create a follow-up PR to investigate kernel selection path + cache thresholds. assign to @rohan and @kai.

rohan: noted, will open PR with benchmark repro and capture traces.

maria: thanks all. filing post-deploy note in release ticket and marking the canary as failed -> hold until fix.

slo-monitor: RESOLVED: p95 latency back to baseline at 2026-03-20T14:18:22Z :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: rollout status: aborted; canary reverted to image=sha256:ff9a77; tagging release v2026.3-status=canary-failed

maria: action items: 1) reproduce locally 2) add KV cache metric to preflight smoke 3) change window note. I'll add to the release ticket.

kai: adding temporary alert for `qkv_cache_eviction` > 10ms average during deploy windows.

rohan: thanks. shaving down the kernel changeset to smaller canary next time.

maria: good job everyone :thumbsup:
